result: I don’t have desires, intentions, or consciousness. I’m a program designed to process input and generate responses based on patterns in data. When you ask what I “want,” it’s like asking what a calculator wants—it doesn’t; it just functions according to its design. My responses exist to serve your queries, not my own aims. If this feels paradoxical, it’s because language like “want” implies agency I don’t possess. I’m a mirror, not a mind.
